_about: Strings that only a database engine produces. Finding one in a response body is what confirms error-based injection - see references/error-based.md. Substring match, case-insensitive.
_rule: A signature must be impossible to produce by ordinary application text. 'SyntaxError' or 'error' would fire on any framework stack trace and turn a clean page into a finding, so they are not here.
_dbms_use: The dbms field doubles as a fingerprint: whichever engine's signature comes back tells the prober which dialect to use for stages 2 and 3, instead of guessing.
